non_goals: No collection of raw request/response bodies, SQL values, credentials, user UUID or device IP payloads
No Remnawave changes or collection of unrelated project logs
No public logging endpoint or DNS change
No proxy data-plane changes or packet/access-history capture
No deletion of other project data to make room for logs
guarantee_boundary: At-least-once delivery within available journal retention and disk buffer capacity; duplicates may occur after replay
30-day retention is time-based; 30GiB is a warning budget, not early deletion
Host disk loss, journal rate limiting, exhausted local journal/buffer capacity and upstream silent events cannot be made lossless by a collector
Logging improves diagnosis but cannot guarantee an exact root cause for every future failure
Per-source writer tokens restrict API roles; this is a trusted internal service, not hostile multi-tenant isolation

evidence.migration: not applicable: new operational log store; no business data migration
